context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/bug_estimator_recalc_api_verification.py for API regression and the source script in /app/tests/bug_estimator_recalc_ui_playwright.py for the UI flow. Due to the right-side Sheet positioning in Playwright, JS clicking the Sheet select triggers is more reliable than locator.click; the final browser run passed with JS click for field-edit_* controls.
rca_of_the_issue: Reported symptom was stale estimates after edits because recalculation previously waited on slow AI insights before setResult. Current implementation updates result from /api/estimator/calculate-fast immediately, then refreshes FX/insights in background. Runtime proof: baseline $47,532,525/92% changed to $20,267,025/88% after edit in 0.237s, then to $21,205,383 after second edit in 0.190s. Backend proof: calculate-fast returned in ~0.1-0.16s with changed totals/breakdown/utilities/BOQ/confidence; full calculate returned totals+insights in 19.426s; /insights returned assumptions/risks/optimizations/executive_summary/source in 18.975s. No MOCKED APIs used.
